title: Host reachability status icon shows "Reachable" for offline/unreachable hosts
author: bruste77
body_snippet:
# Host reachability status icon shows "Reachable" for offline/unreachable hosts (false positives behind Zscaler/ZTNA), plus related bugs found and fixed along the way

## Summary

The connection tree (and a separate button in the Config panel) show a reachability icon
(online/offline) per connection, computed by `mRemoteNG/Tools/HostStatusMonitor.cs` (see issue
#1109). The original implementation determined reachability with a single, weak check: open a raw
TCP connection to the host's port and ...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you — this is a good report, and the two things it can be checked against are both true.

`HostStatusMonitor.IsReachableAsync` really is a bare `TcpClient.ConnectAsync` with no application-layer verification. And your point 3 is real too: `ConfigWindow` carries a **second, independent** reachability check of its own, also a bare TCP connect, so the tree and the Config panel can disagree about the same host for no good reason.
